visualBrief: A long enclosed metro viaduct with a gray corrugated roof, pale blue scalloped skirt, inset solid panels, paired round piers and service walks. Close views include the enclosed track bed and concrete portal walls.
observations: The two metro tracks run inside a long, fully enclosed roof. Corrugated gray upper metal panels join a pale cyan lower skirt.
Each longitudinal roof bay has a scalloped polygonal recess over inset solid panels. The recesses are not windows or open gaps.
Round concrete columns carry wide transverse cap beams and longitudinal precast girders. A narrow continuous walkway and railing run alongside the enclosure.
At both ends the enclosure approaches ground level with concrete portal walls and fences.
limitations: Both tracks follow Protomaps PMTiles and the roof ends follow the aerial footprint. The underground alignments stay native.
Deck elevations, bay spacing, roof height and the short cut-and-cover portal transitions are visual estimates based on exterior photos and standard Terrarium samples.
The enclosed railway has a modeled track bed and structural surfaces. Internal systems and operating trains are outside the reconstruction.
